makeshift_storage_bay.name: Makeshift Storage Bay
makeshift_storage_bay.shortDescription: A improvised storage bay for storing items. Can't store other containers or machines.

storage_bay.name: Storage Bay
storage_bay.shortDescription: A standard bay for storing items.

storage_bay_large.name: Storage Bay (Extended)
storage_bay_large.shortDescription: An expanded bay for storing items.

storage_bay_expansion_kit.name: Storage Bay Expansion Kit
storage_bay_expansion_kit.shortDescription: Use it on a Storage Bay to add two storage tabs, or on an Extended Storage Bay to add one.

machine_bay.name: Machine Bay
machine_bay.shortDescription: A standard bay for storing machines.

machine_bay_ext.name: Machine Bay (Expanded)
machine_bay_ext.shortDescription: A expanded bay for storing machines.

storage_bay_gun.name: Gunsmith Storage Bay
storage_bay_gun.shortDescription: A specialized storage bay for storing firearms and modifications. Can't store other containers or machines.

storage_bay_chem.name: Chemist Storage Bay
storage_bay_chem.shortDescription: A specialized storage bay for storing chemistry equipments and supplies. Can't store other containers or machines.

smuggler_bay_mini.name: Mini Smuggler's Bay
smuggler_bay_mini.shortDescription: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one is mini.

smuggler_bay.name: Smuggler's Bay
smuggler_bay.shortDescription: A small disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection.

smuggler_bay_mod.name: Smuggler's Bay (Modified)
smuggler_bay_mod.shortDescription: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one has been modified to allow for more storage.
